schema:name: PHWExplicitConsent
dcterms:title: PHW Explicit Consent
dcterms:description: A consent the holder gave by their own act: on the wallet, or on a form a health worker recorded (process L). Categorized with an HL7 ActConsentDirective code (OPTIN, OPTINR, OPTOUT or OPTOUTE). The act is the evidence (source[x]). When the trust domain publishes consent codes, policyRule names the code and the version of its text the holder was shown; otherwise policy.uri names the IHE PCF implicit policy the consent changes.
